services.name: Vail History Walking Tours
services.desc: Meet at the Museum on Tuesdays/Thursdays at 11 am to start a 75 minute history walk. Our amazing tour guides will take you on a walking tour of Vail Village! Tours are every Tuesday and Thursday beginning June 10th and will conclude on Thursday, September 25. Tours depart from the Museum at 11 am and are approximately 75 minutes in length. $10/per person; Museum Members and children under 18 are complimentary! services.name: Climb to Glory
services.desc: This 45-minute documentary film, produced by Warren Miller Entertainment, chronicles the legendary history of World War II’s 10th Mountain Division. This 45-minute documentary film, produced by Warren Miller Entertainment, chronicles the legendary history of World War II’s 10th Mountain Division. From training at Colorado’s Camp Hale to helping end the war in Europe with dramatic victories on Italy’s Riva Ridge and Mount Belvedere, Climb to Glory is an entertaining and educational look back at these heroic mountain troopers.
